    68	/**
    69	 * Validate/reserve an enrollment before the deployment script changes the
    70	 * permanent RustDesk password. A single-use token can only hold one active
    71	 * device claim. Repeating a completed single-use deployment is idempotent.
    72	 */
    73	export async function claimEnrollment(
    74	  db: typeof Database,
    75	  rawToken: string,
    76	  input: EnrollmentClaimInput,
    77	): Promise<
    78	  | { alreadyEnrolled: true; deviceId: string }
    79	  | { alreadyEnrolled: false; claimToken: string; expiresAt: string }
    80	> {
    81	  const now = new Date()
    82	  const tokenHash = hashEnrollmentToken(rawToken)
    83	
    84	  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    85	    const [token] = await tx
    86	      .select()
    87	      .from(enrollmentTokens)
    88	      .where(eq(enrollmentTokens.tokenHash, tokenHash))
    89	      .limit(1)
    90	      .for('update')
    91	
    92	    if (!token || token.revokedAt) {
    93	      throw new EnrollmentError(401, 'invalid_token', 'Invalid or revoked enrollment token.')
    94	    }
    95	
    96	    await lockRustdeskId(tx, input.rustdeskId)
    97	    const [existingDevice] = await tx
    98	      .select({ id: devices.id, enrollmentTokenId: devices.enrollmentTokenId })
    99	      .from(devices)
   100	      .where(eq(devices.rustdeskId, input.rustdeskId))
   101	      .limit(1)
   102	
   103	    if (existingDevice && existingDevice.enrollmentTokenId !== token.id) {
   104	      throw new EnrollmentError(
   105	        409,
   106	        'device_exists',
   107	        'This RustDesk ID already exists and is not owned by this enrollment token.',
   108	      )
   109	    }
   110	
   111	    if (token.kind === 'single' && existingDevice) {
   112	      return { alreadyEnrolled: true, deviceId: existingDevice.id }
   113	    }
   114	    if (token.kind === 'single' && token.useCount > 0) {
   115	      throw new EnrollmentError(
   116	        409,
   117	        'token_used',
   118	        'This single-use token has already enrolled a device.',
   119	      )
   120	    }
   121	
   122	    const activeForDevice = await tx
   123	      .select({ id: enrollmentClaims.id, expiresAt: enrollmentClaims.expiresAt })
   124	      .from(enrollmentClaims)
   125	      .where(
   126	        and(
   127	          eq(enrollmentClaims.rustdeskId, input.rustdeskId),
   128	          isNull(enrollmentClaims.finalizedAt),
   129	        ),
   130	      )
   131	    if (activeForDevice.some((claim) => claim.expiresAt > now)) {
   132	      throw new EnrollmentError(
   133	        409,
   134	        'device_claimed',
   135	        'This RustDesk ID already has an active enrollment claim.',
   136	      )
   137	    }
   138	
   139	    const pending = await tx
   140	      .select({
   141	        id: enrollmentClaims.id,
   142	        rustdeskId: enrollmentClaims.rustdeskId,
   143	        expiresAt: enrollmentClaims.expiresAt,
   144	      })
   145	      .from(enrollmentClaims)
   146	      .where(
   147	        and(
   148	          eq(enrollmentClaims.tokenId, token.id),
   149	          isNull(enrollmentClaims.finalizedAt),
   150	        ),
   151	      )
   152	
   153	    const activeClaim = pending.find(
   154	      (claim) =>
   155	        claim.expiresAt > now &&
   156	        (token.kind === 'single' || claim.rustdeskId === input.rustdeskId),
   157	    )
   158	    if (activeClaim) {
   159	      throw new EnrollmentError(
   160	        409,
   161	        'token_claimed',
   162	        'This enrollment token already has an active claim. Resume the existing deployment or wait for it to expire.',
   163	      )
   164	    }
   165	
   166	    // Expired unfinished claims no longer reserve a token/device. Completed
   167	    // claims remain available for idempotent finalize retries.
   168	    await tx
   169	      .delete(enrollmentClaims)
   170	      .where(
   171	        and(
   172	          eq(enrollmentClaims.tokenId, token.id),
   173	          isNull(enrollmentClaims.finalizedAt),
   174	          lt(enrollmentClaims.expiresAt, now),
   175	        ),
   176	      )
   177	
   178	    const claimToken = generateClaimToken()
   179	    const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + CLAIM_TTL_MS)
   180	    await tx.insert(enrollmentClaims).values({
   181	      tokenId: token.id,
   182	      claimHash: hashEnrollmentToken(claimToken),
   183	      rustdeskId: input.rustdeskId,
   184	      alias: input.alias,
   185	      osKey: input.os || null,
   186	      rustdeskVersion: input.rustdeskVersion || null,
   187	      expiresAt,
   188	    })
   189	
   190	    return {
   191	      alreadyEnrolled: false,
   192	      claimToken,
   193	      expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString(),
   194	    }
   195	  })
   196	}

   198	/** Finalize a claimed enrollment and atomically store its permanent password. */
   199	export async function finalizeEnrollment(
   200	  db: typeof Database,
   201	  rawClaimToken: string,
   202	  input: EnrollmentFinalizeInput,
   203	): Promise<{ deviceId: string; rustdeskId: string; created: boolean }> {
   204	  const now = new Date()
   205	  const claimHash = hashEnrollmentToken(rawClaimToken)
   206	
   207	  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
   208	    const [claimRef] = await tx
   209	      .select({ id: enrollmentClaims.id, tokenId: enrollmentClaims.tokenId })
   210	      .from(enrollmentClaims)
   211	      .where(eq(enrollmentClaims.claimHash, claimHash))
   212	      .limit(1)
   213	
   214	    if (!claimRef) {
   215	      throw new EnrollmentError(401, 'invalid_claim', 'Invalid or expired enrollment claim.')
   216	    }
   217	
   218	    // Lock in the same token → claim order used by claimEnrollment to avoid
   219	    // deadlocks between a new claim and a finalize request.
   220	    const [token] = await tx
   221	      .select()
   222	      .from(enrollmentTokens)
   223	      .where(eq(enrollmentTokens.id, claimRef.tokenId))
   224	      .limit(1)
   225	      .for('update')
   226	    const [claim] = await tx
   227	      .select()
   228	      .from(enrollmentClaims)
   229	      .where(eq(enrollmentClaims.id, claimRef.id))
   230	      .limit(1)
   231	      .for('update')
   232	
   233	    if (!token || token.revokedAt || !claim) {
   234	      throw new EnrollmentError(401, 'invalid_token', 'Invalid or revoked enrollment token.')
   235	    }
   236	    if (claim.finalizedAt && claim.deviceId) {
   237	      return {
   238	        deviceId: claim.deviceId,
   239	        rustdeskId: claim.rustdeskId,
   240	        created: false,
   241	      }
   242	    }
   243	    if (claim.expiresAt <= now) {
   244	      throw new EnrollmentError(401, 'invalid_claim', 'Invalid or expired enrollment claim.')
   245	    }
   246	
   247	    await lockRustdeskId(tx, claim.rustdeskId)
   248	    const [existingDevice] = await tx
   249	      .select({ id: devices.id, enrollmentTokenId: devices.enrollmentTokenId })
   250	      .from(devices)
   251	      .where(eq(devices.rustdeskId, claim.rustdeskId))
   252	      .limit(1)
   253	
   254	    if (existingDevice && existingDevice.enrollmentTokenId !== token.id) {
   255	      throw new EnrollmentError(
   256	        409,
   257	        'device_exists',
   258	        'This RustDesk ID already exists and is not owned by this enrollment token.',
   259	      )
   260	    }
   261	    if (token.kind === 'single' && token.useCount > 0 && !existingDevice) {
   262	      throw new EnrollmentError(
   263	        409,
   264	        'token_used',
   265	        'This single-use token has already enrolled a device.',
   266	      )
   267	    }
   268	
   269	    const passwordCipher = encryptSecret(input.password)
   270	    let deviceId: string
   271	    let created = false
   272	
   273	    if (existingDevice) {
   274	      await tx
   275	        .update(devices)
   276	        .set({
   277	          alias: claim.alias,
   278	          customer: token.customer,
   279	          osKey: claim.osKey,
   280	          tags: token.tags,
   281	          lastSeen: now,
   282	          passwordCipher,
   283	          updatedAt: now,
   284	        })
   285	        .where(eq(devices.id, existingDevice.id))
   286	      deviceId = existingDevice.id
   287	    } else {
   288	      const [device] = await tx
   289	        .insert(devices)
   290	        .values({
   291	          rustdeskId: claim.rustdeskId,
   292	          alias: claim.alias,
   293	          customer: token.customer,
   294	          osKey: claim.osKey,
   295	          tags: token.tags,
   296	          status: 'offline',
   297	          lastSeen: now,
   298	          passwordCipher,
   299	          enrollmentTokenId: token.id,
   300	          createdBy: token.createdBy,
   301	        })
   302	        .returning({ id: devices.id })
   303	      deviceId = device.id
   304	      created = true
   305	    }
   306	
   307	    await tx
   308	      .update(enrollmentClaims)
   309	      .set({ finalizedAt: now, deviceId })
   310	      .where(eq(enrollmentClaims.id, claim.id))

   208	function linuxScript(options: DeploymentScriptOptions): string {
   209	  const origin = normalizedOrigin(options.baseUrl)
   210	  const version = DEFAULT_RUSTDESK_VERSION
   211	  const config = options.rustdeskConfig?.trim() ?? ''
   212	  const hashes = DOWNLOAD_SHA256
   213	
   214	  return String.raw`#!/bin/sh
   215	# rustdesk-book deployment for Linux (RustDesk OSS)
   216	# This file contains a bearer token. Store it as root-only and delete it when no longer needed.
   217	set -eu
   218	CLAIM_URL=${shellQuote(`${origin}/api/enroll/claim`)}
   219	FINALIZE_URL=${shellQuote(`${origin}/api/enroll/finalize`)}
   220	ENROLLMENT_TOKEN=${shellQuote(options.token)}
   221	INSTALL_IF_MISSING=${options.installIfMissing ? '1' : '0'}
   222	RUSTDESK_VERSION=${shellQuote(version)}
   223	RUSTDESK_CONFIG=${shellQuote(config)}
   224	
   225	verify_sha256() {
   226	  file=$1
   227	  expected=$2
   228	  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then actual=$(sha256sum "$file" | awk '{print $1}'); else actual=$(shasum -a 256 "$file" | awk '{print $1}'); fi
   229	  if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then echo 'RustDesk package checksum verification failed.' >&2; exit 1; fi
   230	}
   231	
   232	if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
   233	  echo 'Run this deployment as root (sudo).' >&2
   234	  exit 1
   235	fi
   236	
   237	find_rustdesk() {
   238	  if command -v rustdesk >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v rustdesk; return; fi
   239	  for candidate in /usr/bin/rustdesk /usr/local/bin/rustdesk /opt/rustdesk/rustdesk /opt/RustDesk/rustdesk; do
   240	    if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$candidate"; return; fi
   241	  done
   242	  if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   243	    candidate=$(systemctl cat rustdesk.service 2>/dev/null | awk -F= '/^ExecStart=/{print $2}' | cut -d' ' -f1 | head -n 1 || true)
   244	    if [ -n "$candidate" ] && [ -x "$candidate" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$candidate"; return; fi
   245	  fi
   246	}
   247	
   248	RUSTDESK=$(find_rustdesk || true)
   249	if [ -z "$RUSTDESK" ]; then
   250	  if [ "$INSTALL_IF_MISSING" != '1' ]; then
   251	    echo 'RustDesk is not installed or could not be found. Enable automatic installation or install RustDesk first.' >&2
   252	    exit 1
   253	  fi
   254	
   255	  arch=$(uname -m)
   256	  case "$arch" in
   257	    x86_64|amd64) asset_arch=x86_64 ;;
   258	    aarch64|arm64) asset_arch=aarch64 ;;
   259	    *) echo "Unsupported CPU architecture: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;;
   260	  esac
   261	
   262	  tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
   263	  trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
   264	  if [ -f /etc/os-release ]; then . /etc/os-release; else ID=unknown; ID_LIKE=; fi
   265	  family="${'${ID_LIKE:-}'} $ID"

    68	/**
    69	 * Validate/reserve an enrollment before the deployment script changes the
    70	 * permanent RustDesk password. A single-use token can only hold one active
    71	 * device claim. Repeating a completed single-use deployment is idempotent.
    72	 */
    73	export async function claimEnrollment(
    74	  db: typeof Database,
    75	  rawToken: string,
    76	  input: EnrollmentClaimInput,
    77	): Promise<
    78	  | { alreadyEnrolled: true; deviceId: string }
    79	  | { alreadyEnrolled: false; claimToken: string; expiresAt: string }
    80	> {
    81	  const now = new Date()
    82	  const tokenHash = hashEnrollmentToken(rawToken)
    83	
    84	  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    85	    const [token] = await tx
    86	      .select()
    87	      .from(enrollmentTokens)
    88	      .where(eq(enrollmentTokens.tokenHash, tokenHash))
    89	      .limit(1)
    90	      .for('update')
    91	
    92	    if (!token || token.revokedAt) {
    93	      throw new EnrollmentError(401, 'invalid_token', 'Invalid or revoked enrollment token.')
    94	    }
    95	
    96	    await lockRustdeskId(tx, input.rustdeskId)
    97	    const [existingDevice] = await tx
    98	      .select({ id: devices.id, enrollmentTokenId: devices.enrollmentTokenId })
    99	      .from(devices)
   100	      .where(eq(devices.rustdeskId, input.rustdeskId))
   101	      .limit(1)
   102	
   103	    if (existingDevice && existingDevice.enrollmentTokenId !== token.id) {
   104	      throw new EnrollmentError(
   105	        409,
   106	        'device_exists',
   107	        'This RustDesk ID already exists and is not owned by this enrollment token.',
   108	      )
   109	    }
   110	
   111	    if (token.kind === 'single' && existingDevice) {
   112	      return { alreadyEnrolled: true, deviceId: existingDevice.id }
   113	    }
   114	    if (token.kind === 'single' && token.useCount > 0) {
   115	      throw new EnrollmentError(
   116	        409,
   117	        'token_used',
   118	        'This single-use token has already enrolled a device.',
   119	      )
   120	    }
   121	
   122	    const activeForDevice = await tx
   123	      .select({ id: enrollmentClaims.id, expiresAt: enrollmentClaims.expiresAt })
   124	      .from(enrollmentClaims)
   125	      .where(
   126	        and(
   127	          eq(enrollmentClaims.rustdeskId, input.rustdeskId),
   128	          isNull(enrollmentClaims.finalizedAt),
   129	        ),
   130	      )
   131	    if (activeForDevice.some((claim) => claim.expiresAt > now)) {
   132	      throw new EnrollmentError(
   133	        409,
   134	        'device_claimed',
   135	        'This RustDesk ID already has an active enrollment claim.',
   136	      )
   137	    }
   138	
   139	    const pending = await tx
   140	      .select({
   141	        id: enrollmentClaims.id,
   142	        rustdeskId: enrollmentClaims.rustdeskId,
   143	        expiresAt: enrollmentClaims.expiresAt,
   144	      })
   145	      .from(enrollmentClaims)
   146	      .where(
   147	        and(
   148	          eq(enrollmentClaims.tokenId, token.id),
   149	          isNull(enrollmentClaims.finalizedAt),
   150	        ),
   151	      )
   152	
   153	    const activeClaim = pending.find(
   154	      (claim) =>
   155	        claim.expiresAt > now &&
   156	        (token.kind === 'single' || claim.rustdeskId === input.rustdeskId),
   157	    )
   158	    if (activeClaim) {
   159	      throw new EnrollmentError(
   160	        409,
   161	        'token_claimed',
   162	        'This enrollment token already has an active claim. Resume the existing deployment or wait for it to expire.',
   163	      )
   164	    }
   165	
   166	    // Expired unfinished claims no longer reserve a token/device. Completed
   167	    // claims remain available for idempotent finalize retries.
   168	    await tx
   169	      .delete(enrollmentClaims)
   170	      .where(
   171	        and(
   172	          eq(enrollmentClaims.tokenId, token.id),
   173	          isNull(enrollmentClaims.finalizedAt),
   174	          lt(enrollmentClaims.expiresAt, now),
   175	        ),
   176	      )
   177	
   178	    const claimToken = generateClaimToken()
   179	    const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + CLAIM_TTL_MS)
   180	    await tx.insert(enrollmentClaims).values({
   181	      tokenId: token.id,
   182	      claimHash: hashEnrollmentToken(claimToken),
   183	      rustdeskId: input.rustdeskId,
   184	      alias: input.alias,
   185	      osKey: input.os || null,
   186	      rustdeskVersion: input.rustdeskVersion || null,
   187	      expiresAt,
   188	    })
   189	
   190	    return {
   191	      alreadyEnrolled: false,
   192	      claimToken,
   193	      expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString(),
   194	    }
   195	  })
   196	}

   278	          customer: token.customer,
   279	          osKey: claim.osKey,
   280	          tags: token.tags,
   281	          lastSeen: now,

   294	          osKey: claim.osKey,

   308	      .update(enrollmentClaims)
   309	      .set({ finalizedAt: now, deviceId })

   208	function linuxScript(options: DeploymentScriptOptions): string {

   223	RUSTDESK_CONFIG=${shellQuote(config)}

   225	verify_sha256() {
   226	  file=$1
   227	  expected=$2
   228	  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then actual=$(sha256sum "$file" | awk '{print $1}'); else actual=$(shasum -a 256 "$file" | awk '{print $1}'); fi

   233	  echo 'Run this deployment as root (sudo).' >&2

   235	fi
   236

   238	  if command -v rustdesk >/dev/null 2>&1; then command -v rustdesk; return; fi

   240	    if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$candidate"; return; fi

   243	    candidate=$(systemctl cat rustdesk.service 2>/dev/null | awk -F= '/^ExecStart=/{print $2}' | cut -d' ' -f1 | head -n 1 || true)
